# crsf.getSensor

<div class="api-badges"><span class="api-badge api-badge--since">since 1.6.0</span></div>

Return a sensor.

```lua
local sensor = crsf.getSensor()
```

## Parameters

None.

## Returns

sensor ([CrsfSensor](../objects/CrsfSensor/index.md))

## Examples

```lua title="From the official Ethos documentation"
local sensor = crsf.getSensor()
```

## Real-world usage

<div class="api-usage">Called 6 times across 3 open-source Ethos Lua projects. A few short excerpts:</div>

=== "Example 1"

    ```lua
    local function getSensor()
      if not sensor then sensor = crsf.getSensor() end
      return sensor
    end
    ```

    <small>[src/rfsuite/tasks/msp/transport_crsf.lua:22](https://github.com/rotorflight/rotorflight-lua-ethos-suite/blob/53c7e819afe6293cb7623b5972e4a4d276a90ad1/src/rfsuite/tasks/msp/transport_crsf.lua#L22-L25)</small>

=== "Example 2"

    ```lua
    function transport:_ensureSensor()
        if self.sensor then
            return self.sensor
        end
    
        if not crsf or not crsf.getSensor then
            return nil
        end
    
        self.sensor = crsf.getSensor()
        return self.sensor
    end
    ```

    <small>[src/rfsuite/tasks/mspcore/transport_crsf.lua:22](https://github.com/robthomson/ethos-app-framework/blob/fdfd6e70f8f2865a2742102e009b791ae18e3ca9/src/rfsuite/tasks/mspcore/transport_crsf.lua#L22-L33)</small>

=== "Example 3"

    ```lua
    local function getSensor()
      if sensor ~= nil then return sensor end
      if crsf and crsf.getSensor then
        sensor = crsf.getSensor()
      elseif crsf then
        sensor = {
          popFrame = function(_, ...) return crsf.popFrame(...) end,
          pushFrame = function(_, command, payload) return crsf.pushFrame(command, payload) end,
        }
      end
      return sensor
    end
    ```
